sources.title: swissNAMES3D - Swisstopo
sources.snippet: With over 490000 geo-referenced entries, swissNAMES3D is the most comprehensive collection of Swiss geographic names. The free dataset is based on a simple data model and provides the ideal basis for a broad range of applications.
